nodes.body_text: def normalize_clause_numbers(clauses: list[dict]) -> list[dict]: groups = defaultdict(list) for clause in clauses: groups[clause['article_title']].append(clause) reference_candidates = defaultdict(set) corrections = [] known_articles = set() for title in groups: match = ARTICLE.match(title) if match: label = match.group(1) number = int(label) if label.isdecimal() else ORDINALS.get(label) if number is not None: known_articles.add(number) for title, group in groups.items(): article = ARTICLE.match(title) if not article: continue label = article.group(1) expected = int(label) if label.isdecimal() else ORDINALS.get(label) numbered = [(item, PREFIX.match(item['text'])) for item in group] numbered = [(item, match) for item, match in numbered if match] if len(numbered) < 2: continue first, second = numbered[0][1], numbered[1][1] # 0-as-1 is inferred only for a 0,2 sequence with a shared article # number; isolated 0s and unrelated dates and amounts are untouched. if first.group(1) != '0' or second.group(1) != '2' or first.group(3) != second.group(3): continue raw_article = first.group(3) expected_text = str(expected) if expected is not None else None article_fix = (expected_text and raw_article != expected_text and raw_article == expected_text.replace('1', '0') and '1' in expected_text) # Require an article-title match or the known 1-as-0 extraction pattern. if not expected_text or (raw_article != expected_text and not article_fix): continue if article_fix: reference_candidates[raw_article].add(expected_text) for item, match in numbered: if match.group(3) != raw_article: continue ordinal = '1' if item is numbered[0][0] else match.group(1) article_number = expected_text if article_fix else raw_article replacement = ordinal + '-' + article_number before = item['text'] after = replacement + before[match.end():] if before != after: item.setdefault('original_text', before) item['text'] = after corrections.append({'clause_id': item['clause_id'], 'from': match.group(0), 'to': replacement}) for raw, targets in reference_candidates.items(): if len(targets) != 1: continue target = next(iter(targets)) # A leading-zero reference can legitimately refer to another existing # article (e.g. 05 is article 5, not necessarily corrupted 15). if int(raw) in known_articles and int(raw) != int(target): continue expression = re.compile(r"(?<!\w)(ماده\s*)" + re.escape(raw) + r"(?!\d)") for item in clauses: before = item['text'] after = expression.sub(lambda m: m.group(1) + target, before) if before != after: item.setdefault('original_text', before) item['text'] = after corrections.append({'clause_id': item['clause_id'], 'from': 'ماده ' + raw, 'to': 'ماده ' + target}) return corrections

nodes.body_text: class DocxParser: def extract(self, data: bytes) -> str: try: with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)) as archive: entries = archive.infolist() if len(entries) > Settings().docx_max_entries or sum(x.file_size for x in entries) > Settings().docx_max_uncompressed_bytes: raise ValueError("Oversized archive") for item in entries: name = item.filename.replace("\\", "/").lower() if (item.flag_bits & 1 or name.startswith("/") or ".." in name.split("/") or name.endswith(("vbaproject.bin", ".exe", ".dll")) or "/embeddings/" in name or item.file_size > max(item.compress_size, 1) * Settings().docx_max_compression_ratio): raise ValueError("Unsafe archive") doc = Document(io.BytesIO(data)) pieces = [] for block in doc.iter_inner_content(): if isinstance(block, Table): pieces.extend(" | ".join(cell.text for cell in row.cells) for row in block.rows) else: pieces.append(block.text) text = "\n".join(pieces).strip() if not text or len(text) > Settings().extraction_max_chars: raise ValueError("Empty or oversized text") return text except Exception as exc: raise ContractFormatError("Unable to extract DOCX") from exc
